enabled.description: Enable or disable the nftlb daemon.

bind_addresses.description: List of addresses the daemon listens on.

backend_pools.description: List of backend pools (called 'farms' in nftlb JSON config). Each item maps to a farm object.

backends.description: List of backends (called 'backends' in nftlb JSON config). Each item maps to a backend object.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed.

health_check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between health checks for backend servers.

log_level.description: Logging level: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency.

stats_socket.description: Path to the Unix domain socket for statistics and control interface.

enable_debug.description: Enable debug mode (includes verbose logging and extra diagnostics).

farms.description: List of farm (virtual service) definitions, matching nftlb's JSON 'farms' structure (name, iface, oface, family, ether-addr, virtual-addr, virtual-ports, mode, protocol, scheduler, priority, state, backends). Required by nftlb to define services.

name.description: Name of the farm or backend (required in nftlb config).

iface.description: Input interface (only required for DSR mode).

oface.description: Output interface (only required for DSR mode).

family.description: Family of the virtual service: ipv4, ipv6, or dual.

ether_addr.description: Physical (MAC) address of the virtual service or backend (only required for DSR).

virtual_addr.description: IP address for the virtual service (required in nftlb farm config).

virtual_ports.description: Port list separated by commas or ranges separated by a hyphen.

mode.description: Topology: snat, dnat, or dsr (required in nftlb farm config).

protocol.description: Protocol: tcp, udp, sctp, or all.

scheduler.description: Scheduler: weight, rr, hash, symhash (maps to nftlb 'scheduler').

priority.description: Priority availability for backends or farm > 0 (1 by default).

state.description: Set the status of the virtual service or backend: up, down, or off.

ip_addr.description: IP address for the backend (required in nftlb backend config, except for DSR).
